# NEX — Neural Execution Language

NEX is a checked programming language and toolchain for humans and LLMs.
Development toolchain0.157 keeps ordinary source language0.27.
The explicit C++028 source-contract candidate is not enabled in ordinary CLI;
accepted SDK downloads retain their0.156 scope.
Executables run without
an LLM. Precise semantics and small retrieved contexts are design goals;
end-to-end model-token savings remain unmeasured.

## Authority
- [Specification](docs/language.md)
- [Grammar](docs/grammar.ebnf)
- [Capability and guide manifest](llm/language-pack.json)
- [Labelled example corpus](llm/corpus.json)
- [Versioned SDK evidence](docs/releases/0.156.0.json)

Use `nex describe --kind index --json`, then `--field PATH --json`.
Use `nex context --symbol NAME --json` for bounded project context.
The selected compiler and actual tests govern support. PLAN and historical
experiments are not implemented capability lists. Native Windows/CUDA, Metal,
Apple NPU and general GPU compilation remain open platform work.
